pages.text: From Atari Customer Service ATARI 4 SUPER BREAKOUT!” To prevent the coin counter on the Super Breakout game from incrementing on power-up, please perform the following: 1. Clip and lift Pin 15 of the 9334 located at position H8 on the PCB. 2. Run a jumper wire from the lifted pin to Pin 12 of the 7404 at location E3. \ 2175 Martin Avenue - Santa Clara , California 95050 + (408) 984-1900 . (800) 538-6892
